Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Differs from other copy in that only boundaries are colored and some place names are highlighted. The boundary of Georgia is continuous. Includes text on the "French incroachments" and "English title to their settlements on the continent." Scale ca. 1:6,500,000. Library of Congress.
